column1: # Omega portability table (omega-mv#596, slice R3): the rows of the GPU-named files Omega still carries. Every other GPU source,
# and its row, is CUDApp's ($(CUDAPP_SOURCE)/docs/runtime/portability_table.tsv). Checked by: make test-runtime-portability-check.
# Columns, tab separated: file, class, reason, os_binding. Explained in docs/runtime/PORTABILITY.md.
# class: CHIP_SPECIFIC carries knowledge of the GB10 / Blackwell chip or of the driver interface that exposes it; PORTABLE carries neither.

# os_binding: FREESTANDING_PROVEN (a .c file in GPU_FS_SRCS, mk/omega-gpu-engine.mk, built by make gpu-engine-freestanding), NO_HOSTED_INCLUDE (no hosted header by include scan only; not linked freestanding), HOSTED_LIBC (includes stdio, stdlib, time, errno, math or pthread), LINUX_DRIVER (includes nvrm.h, m16_native.h or omega_gpu_platform_linux.h).

column3: Milestone 17 and 18 qualification gates and a silicon vector-add demonstration on GB10; host tooling.
Entry points of the M17 and M18 GB10 qualification gates.
